items.strategy:
Assume AC as declared, inherited from the equivariant constructible category, the flag-variety theorem and the line-bundle Chern and Euler suppliers. Sources: Varagnolo-Vasserot, Canonical bases and KLR-algebras, SS1.1-1.3 (quivers, graded spaces, the incidence varieties, stable flags and the proper projection; PDF pp. 3-4), SS1.5-1.10 (the canonical module, the convolution formulas, the extrashift dictionary and the source-first composition convention; PDF pp. 6-8), SS2.5-2.9 (relative-position strata, their closures and the convolution inclusions; PDF pp. 9-11); Rouquier, Quiver Hecke algebras and 2-Lie algebras, SS3.2.2 (presentation of the quiver Hecke algebra with $Q_{ii}=0$ and hermitian $Q$; PDF pp. 13-15), SS5.3.5-5.3.6 (flag stacks, orbit decomposition and the vector-bundle description; PDF pp. 41-43) and SS5.4.3 (the Hecke generators as Gysin classes; PDF pp. 44-45).
Step 1 (incidence data and dimension). The graded complete flag variety of the word $
u$ is $F_
u\cong\prod_i\operatorname{Flag}(V_i)$, which is smooth projective of dimension $\sum_i eta_i( eta_i-1)/2$; over a chosen flag the stability condition cuts out the vector subspace of $E$ of dimension $\sum_{a>b}h_{
u_a
u_b}$, so $X_
u	o F_
u$ is a vector bundle of that rank and $\pi_
u$ is projective, hence proper. All of this is the supplied statement of [[lem-smooth-flag-incidence-correspondences-have-the-required-oriented-push-pull-calculus]], with the flag factors from [[lem-flag-variety-of-a-vector-space]].
Step 2 (objects and corners). $L_
u=\pi_{
u!}k[d_
u]$ lies in the equivariant bounded constructible category, and the convolution corner convention $e_\eta\mathfrak Ae_
u=\operatorname{Ext}_G(L_\eta,L_
u)$ with product $a*b=b[n]\circ a$ is the one fixed by [[def-equivariant-borel-moore-homology-and-correspondence-convolution]]; the BM degree of the $(\eta,
u)$ corner is $d_\eta+d_
u-n$ by the Ext/BM shift of that definition.
Step 3 (geometric generator classes). Diagonals give the idempotents; capping the diagonal with $x_r=c_1^G(F^r/F^{r-1})$ gives the dots, with the Hom-line identities $c_1(\operatorname{Hom}(D_a,D_b))=\chi_b-\chi_a$ and $c_1(L^*)=-c_1(L)$ from [[prop-first-chern-class-of-tensor-dual-and-conjugate-lines]]. The relative-position class $[C_{s_r
u,
u}]$ is the standard fundamental class of a closed $G$-stable subvariety of $Z_{s_r
u,
u}$, and the signs defining $\sigma_r$ and $	au_r$ are explicit powers of $-1$ attached to the closed stratum, exactly as in the statement; no BM orientation is changed.
Step 4 (presentation and well-definedness). The listed relations define a quotient of the free algebra, so $S_\Gamma( eta)$ is well posed as a graded algebra; the listed grading makes all defining relations homogeneous because $\deg	au_r=-a_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}$ equals $2h_{ij}+d_
u-d_{s_r
u}$ for distinct colors and $-2$ for equal colors. The claims that the geometric classes realize this graded quotient and the polynomial model are the following two theorems, which discharge the definitions well-definedness; the presentation is internal and no generic KLR item is replaced. items.title: Relative-position incidence strata give a faithful geometric PBW basis
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. In the setting of
[[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]], the convolution
algebra $\mathfrak A=\bigoplus_{\eta,\nu}\operatorname{Ext}_G(L_\eta,L_\nu)$ acts by
correspondence composition on the direct sum $P=\bigoplus_\nu P_\nu$ of shifted polynomial
summands $P_\nu=H_G^\bullet(X_\nu;k)[d_\nu]$, where the unit of $P_\nu$ has degree $-d_\nu$
and every $x_r$ has degree $2$, and this action is faithful; here
$H_G^\bullet(X_\nu;k)=k[x_1,\dots,x_m]$ with $m=\sum_i\beta_i$, the variables being the
classes $x_r=c_1^G(F^r/F^{r-1})$ of the preceding definition. Fix one reduced expression of
every $w\in S_m$ and let $\tau_we_\nu$ be the corresponding product of elementary crossings of
[[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]]. Then the elements
$x_1^{c_1}\cdots x_m^{c_m}\tau_we_\nu$ with $c_r\ge0$ form a $k$-basis of $\mathfrak A$;
equivalently, the $\tau_we_\nu$ form a free basis of $\mathfrak A$ over the first-coordinate
polynomial corners $k[x_1,\dots,x_m]$, the polynomials acting by left multiplication. In
particular the dots and the elementary crossings generate $\mathfrak A$. Only relative-position
incidence strata are paved; nothing is asserted about arbitrary stable-flag fibers of
$\pi_\nu$.
items.strategy: Current locally proved argument: Accepted the reader repair after checking all seven current steps and all thirteen direct dependencies. F4 now has the real degree drop 2d. Step 1.1 correctly computes H_G(G/B)=H_T(pt), not the false polynomial extension of H_G(pt). Echelon stabilizers and closed rank filtrations give free closure-class modules; nonzero root and arrow weights give localized fixed-pair matrix units. Step 4.1 proves the necessary scalar-extension identity for dualizing coefficients before using T-module faithfulness. Step 4.2 has unique reduced chains, once-crossed labeled pairs and the monotone allowedness identity, retaining each arrow multiplicity; the triangular basis argument no longer uses the subsequent relation theorem.

items.title: Quiver-flag convolution generators satisfy the signed KLR relations
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. In the setting of [[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]], the geometric classes $e_
u$, $x_r$ and $	au_r$ satisfy every relation of the intrinsic signed presentation $S_\Gamma( eta)$. They act on the shifted polynomial summands by $e_
u$-projection, multiplication by $x_r$, the equal-color formula $	au_r(f)=(f-s_rf)/(x_r-x_{r+1})$ when $
u_r=
u_{r+1}$, and the distinct-color formula $	au_r(f)=(x_r-x_{r+1})^{h_{ij}}s_r(f)$ for $i=
u_r
e j=
u_{r+1}$ on the $
u$-summand with values in the $s_r
u$-summand, where $s_r$ simultaneously swaps the two variables and the two letters. With the unit of $P_
u$ in degree $-d_
u$ and the variables in degree $2$, the generators $e_
u$, $x_r$, $	au_r$ are homogeneous of degrees $0$, $2$, $-a_{
u_r
u_{r+1}}$. Consequently the generator assignment is a graded $k$-algebra homomorphism $S_\Gamma( eta)	o\mathfrak A$ to the BM convolution algebra.

Independently expanded the repeated-adjacent braid patterns by D_2 M_g=M_g D_2 and permutation conjugacy; the all-equal alternant and outer-equal two skew-group expansions give precisely the stated braid quotient. The two direction multiplicities remain arbitrary, including zero. The equal-color degree is correctly -2=-a_ii; faithfulness is used only after operator identities are established.

items.title: Signed KLR algebra is the equivariant Ext algebra of quiver-flag complexes
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. Let $\Gamma$, $\beta$ and $k$ be as in
[[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]]. There is a unique
graded $k$-algebra isomorphism
$$S_\Gamma(\beta)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\operatorname{Ext}_G^\bullet\Bigl(\bigoplus_\nu\pi_{\nu!}k[d_\nu],\bigoplus_\nu\pi_{\nu!}k[d_\nu]\Bigr)$$
sending $e_\nu$, $x_r$, $\tau_r$ to the diagonal, Chern and normalized elementary classes of
[[def-quiver-full-flag-incidence-varieties-and-geometric-klr-generators]], where the Ext
algebra carries the shifted multiplication $a*b=b[n]\circ a$ for homogeneous $a$ of degree $n$.
On the $(\eta,\nu)$ component, Ext degree $n$ corresponds to BM degree $d_\eta+d_\nu-n$. No
semisimplicity, purity or decomposition theorem is used, and finite-dimensionality of the
total Ext algebra is not assumed.
items.strategy: Current locally proved argument: Accepted the reader canonical-coset absorption proof: the four t_j s_i identities use only far moves, braid moves and pair removals, canonical length is inversion number, and reduced words normalize without shortening. Crossing-number induction and dot/crossing inversions then give spanning by finitely many crossing words with arbitrary dot powers, whose geometric images are independent. Checked the corner Ext/BM adjunction proof and the complete product-compatibility proof, including degree shifts, source-first order, units and absence of an extra Koszul sign. Amended the surviving Statement finiteness disclaimer to the precise absence of total-Ext finite-dimensionality, matching current Proof 4.1 and the finite-type hypotheses of F4/F5.

items.title: Signed two-direction multiedge quiver-flag crossing
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. Take the loopless quiver with two vertices $i,j$ and arrow multiplicities $h_{ij}=2$, $h_{ji}=1$, the dimension vector $ eta=2\alpha_i+\alpha_j$ and the word $
u=(i,j,i)$. Then $Q_{ij}(u,v)=(u-v)^3$, and the dimension differences are $d_{s_1
u}-d_
u=h_{ij}-h_{ji}=1$ and $d_{s_2
u}-d_
u=h_{ji}-h_{ij}=-1$. The two triple products of the native braid relation act on the $
u$-summand by $$	au_2	au_1	au_2e_
u=(x_2-x_3)^2s_2\,D_1\,(x_2-x_3)s_2e_
u,\qquad 	au_1	au_2	au_1e_
u=(x_1-x_2)s_1\,D_2\,(x_1-x_2)^2s_1e_
u,$$ where $D_1=(1-s_1)/(x_1-x_2)$ acts on the word $(i,i,j)$, $D_2=(1-s_2)/(x_2-x_3)$ acts on the word $(j,i,i)$, and the distinct-color crossings act by $	au_1e_{(i,j,i)}=(x_1-x_2)^2s_1e_{(i,j,i)}$, $	au_2e_{(i,j,i)}=(x_2-x_3)s_2e_{(i,j,i)}$. Since $
u_1=
u_3=i$, their difference equals the native correction $$ rac{Q_{ij}(x_1,x_2)-Q_{ij}(x_3,x_2)}{x_3-x_1}=- igl[(x_1-x_2)^2+(x_1-x_2)(x_3-x_2)+(x_3-x_2)^2 igr],$$ a nonzero polynomial whenever $h_{ij}+h_{ji}\ge1$. Both oriented crossing factors $(x_1-x_2)^2$ and $(x_2-x_3)$ occur, so the multiedge multiplicities and both arrow directions enter the correction.
items.strategy: Explicit skew-group expansion: The pre-reader calculation is mathematically correct. Independently multiplied the color-dependent crossings in the rational skew group algebra: both authored A and B coefficients match exactly, their longest-permutation coefficients cancel, and their identity coefficients give minus the difference-of-cubes quotient with nonzero x^2 coefficient -1. Checked d_(i,j,i)=4, d_(j,i,i)=5, d_(i,i,j)=3 and normalization exponents 2,1. The reader replaced an undocumented arithmetic assertion with explicit expansions; this is audit enrichment, not a confirmed mathematical defect.

items.title: Equal-color quiver-flag correspondence is nilHecke
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited. Take the one-vertex loopless quiver with no arrows, $ eta=2\alpha_i$ and the unique word $
u=(i,i)$. Then $E=\{0\}$, $F_
u=X_
u=\operatorname{Flag}(\mathbb C^2)=\mathbb P^1$, $d_
u=1$, $Z_{
u,
u}=\mathbb P^1	imes\mathbb P^1$, and the elementary correspondence $	au_1$ acts on the shifted polynomial summand $P_
u=k[x_1,x_2]$ (unit in degree $-1$) by the divided difference $$	au_1(f)= rac{f-s_1f}{x_1-x_2}.$$ In particular $	au_1$ is homogeneous of degree $-2=-a_{ii}$, and $	au_1^2=0$, $	au_1x_1-x_2	au_1=1$, $	au_1x_2-x_1	au_1=-1$; the one-corner convolution algebra is the rank-two nil-Hecke algebra.
items.strategy: Current locally proved argument: Accepted the added PBW dependency and F3: the rank-two polynomial freeness in 1.1 is not supplied by the incidence definition, and satisfying nil-Hecke relations alone does not prove a presentation isomorphism. Current 3.1 reduces the abstract presentation to f+g tau, and its two independent geometric images supplied by PBW give injectivity and surjectivity. Checked E=0, X=P^1, d=1, Z=P^1 times P^1, standard push-pull sign, tau=-[C], D^2=0, both mixed signs and degree -2.
